title: Support scope-compatible systemd-run wait semantics
body: The documented measurement invocation  failed before launching because systemd rejects --wait together with --scope. Recovery removed --wait and monitored the transient scope with systemctl, then stopped the stalled capture by its exact queue-owned process. Provide a documented scope-compatible wait/telemetry wrapper so capped measurements do not require manual invocation repair.

title: Declare generated glyph bindings before SdfCore consumers
body: After the generator changed SdfCore_GlyphOutline to dereference the shared glyph SSBO, seven production shader consumers needed manual include reordering so RecipeGlyphBindings.glsl appears before SdfCoreKernels.g.glsl. The generator or include graph should emit/derive dependency order automatically; consumers should not require hand-maintained binding-before-function ordering.

title: Keep recipe dispatch outputs synchronized with codegen inputs
body: The first queued post-merge recipe_simd_check failed because SdfRecipeCodegenGlslDispatch.g.inc was stale and still contained the pre-path-type duplicate dispatch contract. Recovery required the documented queued recipe_simd_regen target, after which the check passed. Make the consumer codegen dependency graph regenerate this dispatch output automatically when the pinned generator or declaration inputs change.

title: Make VIXEN CMake codegen checks consume the assigned KernelFrameworkRoot instead of a stale cached kernel SHA
body: The final VIXEN sdf_core_kernels_check reused VIXEN_YEROKET_KERNEL_SHA_OVERRIDE=c0ee434bd4c99a64a31871ced8a841ceb8ea2dad from build/wsl even while KernelFrameworkRoot pointed at the assigned glyphkern lane. The direct lane-local CodegenTool --check passed, but the CMake target failed against the stale cached snapshot. Make the selected provider root and SHA explicit or clear stale per-build overrides during reconfigure.

title: Provide a bounded queue-aware cgroup capture helper that preserves child results after the idle watchdog
body: The authoritative text-scene capture required a manual systemd-run scope and a retry after the queued wrapper idle watchdog terminated a silent shader-dump process. The first scope invocation also failed because systemd-run rejects --wait with --scope. Provide one supported helper that applies MemoryMax=16G, emits progress, and returns the child result without confusing scope lifetime with --wait semantics.
